No, keep **one** `Sprite2D`.

A `Sprite2D` can only display one texture **at a time**, but you can change which texture it uses.

In code:

```gdscript
@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite2D
@onready var collision: CollisionPolygon2D = $CollisionPolygon2D

var asteroid_textures := [
	preload("res://assets/asteroids/asteroid_1.png"),
	preload("res://assets/asteroids/asteroid_2.png"),
]

var asteroid_polygons := [
	PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-20, -10), Vector2(0, -25), Vector2(25, -5), Vector2(10, 20), Vector2(-18, 15)]),
	PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-15, -20), Vector2(20, -18), Vector2(25, 10), Vector2(0, 25), Vector2(-25, 5)]),
]

func set_asteroid_variant(index: int) -> void:
	sprite.texture = asteroid_textures[index]
	collision.polygon = asteroid_polygons[index]
```

```text
Asteroid
├── Sprite2D
└── CollisionPolygon2D
```

```gdscript

```

or:

```gdscript

func (g *GameState) SpawnAsteroid(targetX, targetY float64) {
	g.NextID++

	id := EntityID(fmt.Sprintf("asteroid-%d", g.NextID))

	size := rand.Intn(4) + 1      // 1-4
	variant := rand.Intn(4)       // 0-3, matching your 4 textures

	x, y := randomOffscreenPosition()

	dirX := targetX - x
	dirY := targetY - y

	length := math.Sqrt(dirX*dirX + dirY*dirY)
	if length != 0 {
		dirX /= length
		dirY /= length
	}

	speed := 80.0 / float64(size)

	asteroid := &Asteroid{
		ID:        id,
		X:         x,
		Y:         y,
		VelocityX: dirX * speed,
		VelocityY: dirY * speed,
		Size:      size,
		Variant:   variant,
		Rotation:  rand.Float64() * math.Pi * 2,
	}

	g.Asteroids[id] = asteroid
}
```

Offscreen helper:

```go
func randomOffscreenPosition() (float64, float64) {
	width := 1280.0
	height := 720.0
	margin := 100.0

	side := rand.Intn(4)

	switch side {
	case 0: // top
		return rand.Float64() * width, -margin
	case 1: // right
		return width + margin, rand.Float64() * height
	case 2: // bottom
		return rand.Float64() * width, height + margin
	default: // left
		return -margin, rand.Float64() * height
	}
}
```

	for id, asteroid := range g.Asteroids {

		asteroid.Y += asteroid.VelocityY * dt

		if asteroid.X < -300 || asteroid.X > 1580 ||
			asteroid.Y < -300 || asteroid.Y > 1020 {

		}

}
